WALTER / LIVING EXPERIENCE r032

Five moments. One room.

r034 — Landing button depth only. The emerald and ivory actions now have a clearer marble contact lip and stronger grounded shadow. Pointer hover raises them one pixel; pressing compresses them two pixels. Keyboard focus stays visible; reduced motion keeps the state without travel.

The pair's location, size, text and actions remain unchanged. Other pages, artwork, room, forms, simulations and ambience remain exactly as in r033. This is a protected visual review, not a public deployment.

Ambience pauses while typing, in dialogs, offscreen and in hidden tabs. Reduced motion stays static. Touch devices start with ambience paused and can opt in.

Layer controls

Device performance and final continuous-motion approval remain for review. The older public sharing link is unchanged.
